Name: Marvell Technology Group Ltd
Description: Marvell Technology Group Ltd is a leading provider of infrastructure semiconductor solutions that enable the digital transformation of networks, data centers, and enterprise storage. Headquartered in Wilmington, Delaware, the company specializes in advanced technologies, including analog, mixed-signal, and digital signal processing integrated circuits, driving innovation across key markets such as cloud computing, 5G, and automotive. With a commitment to high-performance solutions, Marvell is well-positioned to capitalize on the growing demand for connectivity and data management in an increasingly digital world.
Address: 1000 NORTH WEST STREET, WILMINGTON, DE, UNITED STATES, 19801
